title: Lateness Bands Beyond the Grace Period — Appointment Series Late Arrivals
content:
Scheduling standard on how far past the grace period a late arrival on an Appointment Series came, and the share of the late-arrival fee that follows.

**Rule.** The late-arrival lateness share is 50 percent where the patient arrived no more than 10 minutes beyond the grace period, 75 percent where the patient arrived more than 10 but no more than 20 minutes beyond the grace period, and 100 percent where the patient arrived more than 20 minutes beyond the grace period. The share is read as a percentage of the late-arrival basis and multiplies it.

**Measurement.** The minutes late are those carried on the most recent zero-notice cancellation entry on the series, the one with the latest appointment date; the minutes beyond the grace period are those minutes late less the grace period of the series' format.

| Visit format | Grace period | 50 percent (minutes late) | 75 percent (minutes late) | 100 percent (minutes late) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 15 minutes | up to 25 | 26 to 35 | 36 or more |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 15 minutes | up to 25 | 26 to 35 | 36 or more |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 10 minutes | up to 20 | 21 to 30 | 31 or more |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 15 minutes | up to 25 | 26 to 35 | 36 or more |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 15 minutes | up to 25 | 26 to 35 | 36 or more |

The Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series, with a 10-minute grace period, records an arrival beyond its grace period as a no-show, so its late arrivals do not carry this fee.

**Edges (hypothetical).** On an Aquatic Therapy Visit Series, 20 minutes late is 10 minutes beyond the grace period and takes 50 percent; 21 minutes late takes 75 percent. On a Standard 45-Minute Visit Series, 35 minutes late takes 75 percent and 36 minutes late 100 percent.
